scope: Current repository behavior before any change to model prompts or ranking/selection logic.

paperSearch.searchTextOrigin: Legacy Gemini keyword extraction from the user's research question.
paperSearch.reason: PaperMind calls the bulk-search endpoint. It sends no sort parameter; the documented bulk endpoint default is paperId ascending and is intended for bulk retrieval without search relevance.
paperSearch.paperMindSelection: If more than 20 candidates are returned, choose the first encountered paper for each publication type, then fill remaining slots in upstream order. This changes the upstream order and can privilege publication types.
paperSearch.citationModeOrdering: After selection, APIController sorts the selected list by citationCount descending. ListViewCitation also initially sorts by citation count; users may change the client-side sort.
paperSearch.opinionModeOrdering: No citation-count sort in the initial API response. ListViewOpinion sorts by publication year (newest first) by default.

classification.providerPath: GeminiService (direct Gemini REST call), not LangChain4jGeminiGateway.
classification.input: The user's research question and selected search-result paper JSON.
classification.rankingEffect: No relevance ranking is produced; the output groups paper IDs and affects opinion graph categories/filtering.

abstractSummary.evidence: Abstract text on the server-stored ResearchPaper; no full-paper reading is implied.
abstractSummary.responseShape: JSON object {paperId, summary, basis}; summary itself is non-empty plain text, not JSON generated content.
abstractSummary.emptySummaryBehavior: HTTP 502; empty output is not cached.

reports.providerPath: EvidenceReportService -> AiTextGateway.generateJson -> LangChain4jGeminiGateway with JSON response format.
reports.evidenceSynthesis: Selected server-stored abstracts and optional server-stored supporting/opposing classifications.
reports.citationContext: Semantic Scholar contexts sampled from up to five focal papers and up to five citing papers per focal paper.
reports.providerFailureBehavior: Gateway may retry with configured fallback model; unresolved failures surface as service-unavailable. Invalid/empty report JSON is rejected as bad gateway.

evaluation.reason: The fixture's annotations are explicitly unreviewed, so quality metrics would be fabricated without a human-reviewed gold set.
